Shape: **Routine** — this is a bounded prompt-contract change with existing verdict and gate support.

**What we know:** `.swarm/prompts/planner.md:8-17` requires the full structure before its Routine exception; `.swarm/prompts/reviewer.md:12` always requires an audit table. Matching templates live under `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/`. `TestDeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync` provides the sync/scaffolding test pattern; `TestAgentReviewCannotBeReboundAfterInputsChange` already uses verdict-only approval.

**What we're assuming:** explicit Routine precedence resolves the prompt conflict; inspect the final text against each acceptance criterion. **Open questions:** none blocking; generated prose length is guidance, not a runtime guarantee.

1. Update `.swarm/prompts/planner.md` and its template so Routine overrides the general structure: confirmed cause/files, smallest change, acceptance-to-test mapping, and unresolved risks only. Set a soft 150–250-word target, expandable for correctness; explicitly waive general headings, alternatives, and objective/constraint restatements. Keep both artifacts and identify the shape briefly. Preserve other shapes' requirements.
2. Update `.swarm/prompts/reviewer.md` and its template: Routine produces the exact existing first-line verdict plus actionable findings only, with verdict-only approval when there are none. Waive the audit table and plan recap only for Routine; retain all review checks and other shapes' behavior.
3. Add `internal/harness/routine_prompt_test.go`, following the existing sync test, to cover both roles' repository/template equality, scaffolded prompts, Routine exceptions, and preserved other-shape instructions. Add `changes/unreleased/197-compact-routine-contract.md`.
4. Run TEST_PLAN.md checks. Leave approval, digest, parser, workflow, and existing tests unchanged. Developer notes belong in IMPLEMENTATION.md; tester results in VALIDATION.md.

## Operator guidance

> Developer: record notes in .swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: record results in .swarm/active/VALIDATION.md. Both: the coordinator reruns every required check; run targeted tests (-run, single packages) and at most one full-suite run at the end.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

# ISSUE-197 acceptance verification

| Acceptance | Cases and evidence | Command |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Compact Routine planner contract | New `TestRoutinePlannerPromptContractAndSync`: compare repository and embedded template (normalize CRLF), initialize a temporary repository and inspect scaffolded output. Assert confirmed cause/files, smallest change, acceptance mapping, optional risks, soft 150–250 words with correctness expansion, and explicit waivers of general headings, alternatives, objective/constraints restatement. Read the whole prompt to ensure unconditional instructions do not override the exception and both artifacts remain required. | `go test ./internal/harness -run '^TestRoutinePlannerPromptContractAndSync$'` |
| 2. Compact Routine review; other shapes preserved; copies synchronized | New `TestRoutineReviewerPromptContractAndSync`: same equality/scaffold checks; assert exact verdict choices, actionable findings only, verdict-only clean approval, no Routine audit table or recap, and retained review rigor. In both new tests cover the preserved Involved, Exploratory, and Urgent guidance; inspect the diff to confirm changes apply only to Routine and surrounding dispatch language. | `go test ./internal/harness -run '^TestRoutine(Planner\|Reviewer)PromptContractAndSync$'` |
| 3. Digests and human gates unchanged | Run existing approval authentication, input-binding, human-gate, and fail-closed parser tests without modifying them. Inspect the diff to confirm no authority or validation implementation changes and no edits to existing tests. | Commands below. |
| 4. make check passes | Run formatting, vet, staticcheck, and race-enabled suite via the existing target once at the end. Record outcomes and any environmental blockers; coordinator reruns all required checks. | `make check` |

Targeted regression commands:

```bash
go test ./internal/lease -run 'Test(ReviewApprovalRequiresAuthenticatedConsistentEvidence|AgentReviewCannotBeReboundAfterInputsChange|CurrentPlanHumanApprovalRequired)$'
go test ./internal/cli -run '^TestCLIHumanGateCannotBeBypassedByReviewOrSubmit$'
go test ./internal/workflow -run '^TestParseReviewVerdictFailsClosed$'
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Review the changelog fragment for a short description of Routine planning/review behavior. New prompt tests should fail against the original prompts. Prompt assertions verify the instructions, not a model's generated word count.

Follow operator limits: use targeted tests during development and at most one full-suite run at the end (`make check` supplies that run). The coordinator separately runs the approved fmt/build/vet/staticcheck/test checks; do not duplicate its full suite. Developer records notes in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`; tester records results in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`. This planning phase does not execute implementation checks.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED

| Item | Status | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC1 Routine planner contract | Covered | Step 1 + `TestRoutinePlannerPromptContractAndSync`. |
| AC2 Routine reviewer; other shapes unchanged; copies in sync | **Gap** | Planner and reviewer copies are not in sync today (see F1). |
| AC3 Digest binding / human gate unchanged | Covered | Cited tests exist: `internal/lease/manager_test.go:104,469,545`, `internal/cli/cli_test.go:247`, `internal/workflow/engine_test.go:394`. Verdict-only body is accepted (`manager_test.go:545`). |
| AC4 make check | Covered | `Makefile:44` `check: lint race`. |
| Constraints (harness flag, changelog) | Covered | `allow_harness_changes: true`; fragment `changes/unreleased/197-compact-routine-contract.md`. |
| Shape fit / scope | OK | Routine is the right shape and the plan is appropriately short. |

## Findings

**F1: "Matching templates" is presented as a fact, but it is wrong.** `diff .swarm/prompts/planner.md internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/planner.md` shows the template has two sections the repository copy lacks: "Recommend a split when the work cannot fit one claim" (exercised by `TestPlannerSplitRecommendationInstructions`, `scaffold_test.go:1247`) and "PR revision context". `reviewer.md` likewise lacks the template's "PR revision context" section. Only `developer.md` and `tester.md` match today. The runtime prompt comes from the repository copy (`internal/harness/scaffold.go:773`), so the new equality assertions in Step 3 will fail unless the copies are reconciled first. Reconciling them also changes what this repository's agents see for every shape, which touches AC2's "Involved, Exploratory and Urgent prompts are unchanged".

Required revision: correct **What we know**, then add an explicit step that makes the template the canonical source. Bring the repository `planner.md` and `reviewer.md` up to the template content before applying the Routine edits identically to both copies. State that the split and revision sections are synced in unchanged, not rewritten. Add a TEST_PLAN line confirming that the per-shape bullets for Involved, Exploratory and Urgent are byte-identical before and after (for example, assert that the original bullet strings still appear). If the maintainer would rather not sync the drift in this WorkUnit, the plan must say so and name a follow-up. Without that, AC2's sync test cannot pass.

**F2 (minor): the reviewer Routine exception must not weaken checks 2–4.** Step 2 says "retain all review checks". The test for AC2 should also assert that the Routine exception covers only REVIEW.md's *output format* (no audit table, no plan recap) and keeps the audit duties in steps 2–4 of the reviewer contract. The planned test describes this loosely as "retained review rigor". Name the strings it asserts.

No other changes are needed. Approval/digest, parser, and gate code stay untouched as the plan states.
